'''Elin Roe's fifth moon''' was a [[Moon/Legends|natural satellite]]<ref name="CRO" /> located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the fifth moon [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the celestial body [[Elin Roe]]<ref name="CRO" /> of the [[Elin Roe system/Legends|Elin Roe system]].<ref name="TEA" /> At some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Yagaran Four]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] team pursued on Elin Roe a target on which a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] had been posted. During the chase, the team activated the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] of their [[Unidentified YT-1300 light freighter|YT-1300 light freighter]]. However, the [[Engine/Legends|drive]] unit, which had previously been subjected to a dangerous modification by the [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] known as "[[Maniac]]," exploded, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Yagaran Four and emitting a [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]] of [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] dust that washed over the fifth moon of Elin Roe. Maniac was subsequently credited with the minor-scale disaster.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Elin Roe's fifth moon was created by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and was introduced in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a [[1994]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CRO" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Elin Roe [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the moon, in grid square N-12.<ref name="TEA" />
